turns.speaker: Ray Patel
turns.text: Hey everyone, I'm Ray. Ray Patel. I'm a software engineer at Stripe, and I live in Brooklyn with my dog Biscuit.

turns.speaker: Jasper Lin
turns.text: I'm Jasper Lin. I work as a nurse at Mount Sinai, and I play bass in a band called the Night Owls.

turns.speaker: Sophie Moreau
turns.text: Hi, I'm Sophie Moreau. I'm a grad student at Columbia studying architecture, and I just moved here from Montreal.

turns.speaker: Sophie Moreau
turns.text: So Ray and Jasper, how did you two meet?

turns.speaker: Ray Patel
turns.text: We met freshman year at Cornell. We were roommates in the fall of 2016, and Jasper kept stealing my cereal.

turns.speaker: Jasper Lin
turns.text: That is true, but I made up for it. I drove Ray to the hospital when he broke his arm skiing in 2017.

turns.speaker: Ray Patel
turns.text: Actually, I think that was 2018, junior year.

turns.speaker: Jasper Lin
turns.text: No way. It was definitely 2017, right before spring break.

turns.speaker: Ray Patel
turns.text: Anyway, we both moved to New York after graduation in 2020, and we still climb together every Tuesday at Brooklyn Boulders with Maya and Theo. We call ourselves the Tuesday climbing crew.

turns.speaker: Sophie Moreau
turns.text: Jasper and I actually dated for about a year. We met at Electric Zoo in 2019.

turns.speaker: Jasper Lin
turns.text: No, it was 2018. Electric Zoo 2018, on Randall's Island. You lost your phone in the mud.

turns.speaker: Sophie Moreau
turns.text: Okay, fine, it was 2018. We broke up in 2019, but we are still good friends.

turns.speaker: Jasper Lin
turns.text: Andrew Gao is my coworker at Mount Sinai. He is a doctor in the emergency room.

turns.speaker: Sophie Moreau
turns.text: And Andrew Moy is my cousin. He is the one who introduced me to Ray last year.

turns.speaker: Ray Patel
turns.text: We all went to Electric Zoo again in 2022, and Andrew came with us. He got us backstage passes.

turns.speaker: Sophie Moreau
turns.text: Ray, didn't you get engaged recently?

turns.speaker: Ray Patel
turns.text: Yes! I proposed to my girlfriend Priya in Lisbon in September 2025. She said yes on the first try.

turns.speaker: Jasper Lin
turns.text: Priya is great. She and I went to the same high school in New Jersey, so I have known her since 2012.
